description: This source file defines the class NeFunction which implements a filter function for inequality (not equal) comparison, used within a filtering framework in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: NeFunction
classes.description: Implements a filter function that returns true if two parameters are not equal.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of this filter function, which is 'ne'.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Returns true if the two parameters are not equal; false otherwise. If the number of parameters is not exactly two, returns false.
